### DOOH and Campaign Lifecycle 3.2 Release Progress
- **Status:** active
- **Summary:** The working group reports 3.2 is nearly feature-complete, with DOOH audio handling as one of the last stragglers. ### Experimental Buyer-Agent-as-Principal Tooling
- **Status:** active
- **Summary:** As part of the 3.2 cycle, the group is introducing experimental support for treating buyer agents as principals, described as the first formal recognition of stateful buyers within the protocol. Reporting pipeline merges are also being introduced as experimental. The working group intends to discuss these experimental additions alongside the 3.3 and evergreen backlog to ensure no high-priority items are missed.

### llms.txt Structure Change Breaking Tooling Assumptions
- **Status:** active
- **Summary:** A member flagged that the `llms.txt` index served from the docs site has changed shape multiple times and, as of early September, is now a multi-version hub whose flat entries point to archived 2.5.x docs while current release docs live behind per-version sub-indexes (e.g., 3-1, 3-2-beta, 3-0). There is no "latest" alias, and naively picking the highest version string leads tooling to the beta rather than the current stable release; a stable path with a redirect is suggested as the reliable way to find current docs. This affects any agent or skill tooling built to consume the docs index programmatically.
- **Thread:** https://agenticads.slack.com/archives/C09J28K9K29/p1788451422017619
